title: Ada and the Postcard
author: Ines Underhill
blurb: Emrys Almeida, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
